QuestInfo.name: Master of Herbalism 2
QuestInfo.0: See Grant to learn how to master Herbalism.
QuestInfo.1: Obtain the rare #b#t4007004##k from refining, and take it to Grant.
QuestInfo.2: Go see Grant again once you reach Herbalism Lv. 7.

0.0: You know why you're here. As before, I need proof of your determination. This time, bring me a #b#t4007004##k.

yes.0: #b#t4007004##k can be obtained by refining #r#t4022011##k or #r#t4022012##k Since they are rather rare, it will require some patience. I wish you luck.

no.0: You must devote yourself to Herbalism in order to master it. Come back when you can make that commitment.

default.0: I don't think you have everything I asked you to get. Come back when you have everything.
